changes: Repository-aware design context includes selected native scene graph, actual preview, ranked components, prop contracts, tokens and routes.
New compositions and palettes are allowed by default; keeping the current layout is optional.
Source component instancing supports real props and preserves native component bindings; captured element cloning retains styling.
Reuse checks request correction and block import when available project components or captured elements are not used.
Zero-height overflow-visible wrappers preserve visible controls rather than collapsing an editable page to a raster.
Text-only bound components remain visible in canvas and previews.
Creation honours radius, borders, shadows, gradients and typography parameters.
New text with unspecified dimensions uses measured auto sizing; rendered overflow and sibling text overlap are reported.
Effort levels come from official Claude Code model capability metadata, persist per model and are sent using --effort.
FrameUI exposes design-only AI tools and rejects repository implementation requests.

Developer handoff is available after approval and in the main Export dialog. It includes native and normalized editable design files, previews, assets, fonts, component/prop mappings, tokens, full prototype data, test scenarios, source fingerprints, notes and a Claude Code implementation brief.
